CheckTitle: Bedrock AgentCore agent runtime requires an inbound authorizer
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: **Bedrock AgentCore agent runtimes** host the invocation endpoint for an agent. This check verifies each agent runtime configures a custom JWT inbound authorizer rather than falling back to the default IAM SigV4 authentication, which authenticates the calling IAM principal but carries no end-user identity.
Risk: An **agent runtime** with no `authorizerConfiguration` falls back to IAM SigV4, which authenticates the calling AWS principal but propagates no validated end-user identity, so the agent cannot scope its actions or tool access to the person it acts for. SigV4 is correct for service-to-service calls; this check concerns runtimes reached by end users.

Code.NativeIaC:
```yaml
Resources:
  example_resource:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Runtime
    Properties:
      AgentRuntimeName: example_resource
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: https://example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration  # Critical: requires an inbound authorizer
```
Code.Other:
1. Open the AWS Console and go to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
2. Select **Agent Runtimes** from the navigation pane
3. Edit the agent runtime
4. Configure an inbound authorizer (custom JWT)
5. Save the agent runtime

Recommendation.Text: Where an agent runtime is invoked on behalf of end users, configure a custom JWT inbound authorizer so `InvokeAgentRuntime` carries a validated end-user identity rather than only the calling IAM principal. A runtime supports one method at a time, so a runtime reached only by other AWS services may keep IAM SigV4 deliberately.

Notes: This check reports one finding per AgentCore agent runtime discovered via ListAgentRuntimes/GetAgentRuntime in each scanned region. A runtime whose GetAgentRuntime detail could not be retrieved returns MANUAL rather than FAIL, because an absent authorizerConfiguration means the answer is unknown, not that no authorizer is configured.
